purpose: Define reusable Lens presets as explicit parameter/configuration snapshots over an existing Lens identity without becoming new source semantics or hidden canonical defaults.

topics.name: Lens Preset
topics.purpose: Define reusable Lens presets as explicit parameter/configuration snapshots over an existing Lens identity without becoming new source semantics or hidden canonical defaults.

semantics.preset_rule: Preset references one exact Lens identity/version and stores explicit parameter values/configuration.
semantics.identity_rule: Each reusable preset has an explicit identity.
semantics.source_rule: Preset does not copy Lens source data or source semantic ownership.
semantics.default_rule: A default preset is explicit metadata, never inferred from most-recent use.
semantics.personal_rule: User-specific presets and shared canonical presets are distinguishable by scope/owner.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Preset validates against Lens parameter schema/version before use.
semantics.migration_rule: Incompatible Lens changes require explicit preset migration/invalid state.
semantics.authority_rule: Preset cannot grant source access beyond Lens/current caller policy.

invariants.rule: Studio and Lens compose and project existing canonical semantics; analysis, presets and visualizations never silently become source semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: last-used state silently becomes canonical default
user-private preset treated as shared canonical preset
